_method: Zone labels read from the PDF text layer. Garages identified from the label printed on each zone. Street/lot zones placed by fitting the PDF to 8 known building coordinates (residuals 5-26 m) and matched to the nearest UMD pay stations (35-59 m). Zones 6124 and 6127, and the off-map inset zones 6119/6120, matched no pay station in UMD's data and are deliberately not assigned.
pay_link_note: ParkMobile's web app; the zone is typed in on the page. No documented URL parameter pre-fills a zone, so none is used.

Eppley Rec Center/ Pool.where: Valley Drive, by Eppley Recreation Center

School of Public Health.where: Valley Drive, by the School of Public Health

City Garage.text: Pay at the garage's electronic pay stations by credit card, or with the mobile app named on the station. The City does not name the app online.

Cambria.text: Privately run hotel garage: book through a parking app or pay the hotel directly.
